description: Use this when someone asks about one specific PadConsole game (player count, genre, what it is like, whether friends in other homes can join). Takes a game id returned by another tool or a title. Returns a description and a link to the game page.

locale.description: Language the user is writing in: tr (Turkish), de (German), es (Spanish), id (Indonesian) or en (everything else). Default en.

name: get_game_details
title: Get game details
